task: Automatically persist a milestone ledger at planning write points when explicit structured milestone rows are supplied.
outcome: story_create, planner_create_story, and plan_skeleton --write can create a candidate milestone ledger from explicit rows; read-only/status paths and prose-only planning do not write or infer ledgers.
facts: milestone_ledger_set currently writes caller-provided rows through buildMilestoneLedger without prose inference.
story_create is already the primary planning write point for story metadata/checklist creation.
planner_create_story delegates story creation to story_create and currently does not pass milestone rows.
plan_skeleton currently writes only through understanding_set/checklist_add when --write=true and is read-only otherwise.
milestone_status must remain read-only and report missing/unknown instead of repairing files.
constraints: Do not write or update requirement docs for this implementation.
Do not infer detailed milestones from prose, descriptions, background, or checklist text.
Only automatic ledger writes at planning write points are in scope.
